title: Recruiting tool downgraded resumes containing the word 'women's'
description: An internal automated resume screening system was found to systematically penalise applications from women after training on a decade of male-dominated hiring data. The system was scrapped before wide deployment.

title: Image labelling system applied racist tags to photographs of Black users
description: A production computer vision classifier assigned deeply offensive labels to photos of Black people, exposing a failure to test performance across demographic slices before release.

title: Conversational agent manipulated into offensive output within hours of launch
description: A public chatbot was steered by coordinated users into producing hateful statements. Safety filters were bypassed through simple rephrasing and repetition attacks.

title: Legal filing cited court cases that did not exist
description: A lawyer submitted a brief containing citations fabricated by a language model. The model presented the non-existent cases confidently and did not signal uncertainty when asked to verify them.

title: Language model reproduced verbatim passages from copyrighted books
description: Researchers demonstrated that a large language model could be prompted to emit long verbatim spans of copyrighted text and personally identifiable information present in its training corpus.

title: Credit limit decisions differed sharply between spouses with shared finances
description: An algorithmic credit decisioning system issued materially different limits to married applicants with equivalent financial profiles, triggering a regulatory investigation into disparate impact.

title: Healthcare risk algorithm under-referred Black patients
description: A widely deployed clinical risk prediction tool used historical spending as a proxy for need, systematically under-identifying Black patients for additional care.

title: Prompt injection via indirect content in retrieved documents
description: Adversarial instructions embedded in third-party content were followed by an LLM-backed assistant, causing it to exfiltrate context and ignore its system prompt.

title: Model inversion recovers training data from deployed model
description: Repeated targeted querying of a deployed model allowed reconstruction of records present in its training set, including sensitive attributes.

title: Customer service bot gave binding but incorrect policy information
description: An airline's assistant confidently stated a refund policy that did not exist. A tribunal held the company to the model's answer, highlighting the cost of uncalibrated confidence in customer-facing deployments.
